description: This file defines the SalesforceGraphQLClient class responsible for querying Salesforce data via GraphQL, including methods for retrieving account and contact information based on email and related rules. It includes logic for dynamic query building, error handling, and applying field rules for filtering.

classes.name: SalesforceGraphQLClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Salesforce via GraphQL, including methods for retrieving account and contact data based on email and rules.

methods.name: GetAccountRecordsForRRSkip
methods.description: Retrieves account or contact records from Salesforce based on email, applying optional field rules, and following a multi-tiered logic to find the best match.

methods.name: getFailingFieldRule
methods.description: Checks if an account node passes all configured field rules, returning the first rule that fails or null if all pass.

methods.name: buildDynamicAccountQuery
methods.description: Constructs a GraphQL query string that includes additional account fields for rule evaluation.

methods.name: getAllPossibleAccountWebsiteFromEmailDomain
methods.description: Utility method to generate possible website values from an email domain.
